name: Two-year operational spares
description: Two-year operational spares for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Commissioning. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: MAN PrimeServ spare parts packages (EX — standardised spare parts packages
specifications.basis: MAN 'Prepare for MAN 175D' printed June 2022: post-commissioning, mechanical, after-treatment and automation packages; reconditioned exchange components include cylinder heads, turbochargers, fuel injectors and cooling water pumps, remanufactured at Frederikshavn, Denmark. These are MAN parts and are expressly excluded by the BOQ wording.

specifications.metric: MAN PrimeServ spare parts packages (EX — high-demand OEM spare parts delivery target
specifications.basis: MAN brochure printed June 2022: 'Prompt delivery of high-demand OEM spare parts within 24 hours'; Singapore and Denmark stock referenced in MAN 'Essential spare parts' material - out-of-scope MAN parts, included only as market context.

specifications.metric: GE contractual service agreement (long — CSA duration at Kimanis Power plant
specifications.basis: GE press release 14 June 2011: GE signed a contractual service agreement with Kimanis Power Sdn Bhd to support the 300 MW plant for 18 years; CSAs described as providing predictable maintenance costs and high availability.
